_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Template for `ael extinction`: replace every value with your own measurements. Paths are relative to this file. Run it on the linear stack, before any filter; then run `ael filters` on the corrected stack. k is an input you must measure (e.g. ael.extinction.dimming_k on same-exposure frames of totality); the correction is a consistency test, not a measurement of k.
